title: Electronic catalogue
intro: Fonds, inventories, case files and documents of the State Archive of East Kazakhstan Region.

tree.emptyCases: This inventory has no published case files.
tree.emptyDocuments: This case file has no documents approved for publication.
tree.inventoriesLead: An inventory lists the case files of one fonds.
tree.casesLead: A case file is a folder of documents on one matter.
tree.emptyList: The catalogue has no published records.
tree.nothingFound: Nothing matches this query. Check the number or shorten the title.
tree.otherCases: All case files of the inventory

funds.intro: Search by the current or a former name of the organisation, the fonds number or the year of the records.
funds.qPlaceholder: For example: Pushkin library, city executive committee, Р-103
funds.earlierNames: {count, plural, one {# former name} other {# former names}}
funds.partial: access to some files is restricted
funds.units: {count, plural, one {# storage unit} other {# storage units}}
funds.emptyText: Try shortening the name to one or two words, or remove the year or type. The organisation may have had a different name — the search covers all former names.
funds.sourceNote: Source: lists of fonds published by the archive on e-arhiv.vko.gov.kz (data as of 2018). Classified fonds are not published.
funds.partialNote: Access to some storage units of this fonds is restricted. The description is open; ask the archive about the conditions for working with the records.
funds.namesText: What the records creator was called over the years. The fonds can be found by any of these names.
funds.noInventories: The inventories and case files of this fonds are consulted in the archive's reading room.

certificate.title: Need a certificate from this fonds?
certificate.text: An archival certificate, copy or extract is issued free of charge within 11 working days. In the application give the fonds number {number} and the organisation's name.

ask.button: Ask the assistant about this fonds
ask.question: Tell me about fonds No. {number}: whose records are these and which years do they cover?

newspapers.title: Newspaper holdings
newspapers.intro: Bound newspaper volumes kept by the archive: titles, publishers and years. The volumes are consulted in the reading room.
newspapers.years: {count, plural, one {Volumes for # year} other {Volumes for # years}}
newspapers.empty: No newspapers match these conditions. Try another title or year.
newspapers.sourceNote: Source: the list of newspapers published by the archive on e-arhiv.vko.gov.kz (as of 1 January 2018).

search.label: Search documents
search.field: Title, reference code, author or topic
search.placeholder: For example: приказ о пуске цеха
search.invalid: Some conditions in the address are invalid (for example, the year or a date), so the whole catalogue is shown.

search.label: Search the whole site
search.text: Semantic search finds documents, fonds, exhibitions and site pages even when the words do not match.

funds.label: List of fonds
funds.text: Find an organisation by its current or former name.

assistant.label: Ask the archive assistant
assistant.text: Describe what you are looking for in your own words — the assistant suggests where it may be kept.
